part2.question: Describe a story/book with animals in it

segments.v: I want to talk about Diary of a Cricket by Tô Hoài. It is a famous Vietnamese book. There are many animals in it, like crickets, grasshoppers, frogs and birds. The main character is Dế Mèn, a young cricket. He is strong but very proud. In one chapter, he makes fun of a bird called Chị Cốc. The bird is angry and attacks Dế Choắt, his weak neighbour, and Dế Choắt dies. Dế Mèn feels very sad and sorry. After that, he goes on many adventures and becomes a better person. I read this story because it was in my literature textbook in grade 6. I think it is a very good story. It teaches children not to be proud and to care about others.
